{{Quote|First confirmed sighting was during the boarding of Imperial dreadnought ''Warhammer''&mdash;Lokin was one of the two individuals aboard who evaded capture. Interestingly, he was not listed in the crew roster.|SIS dossier on Lokin|<ref name="Codex" />}}
During the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]],<ref name="Codex" /> which lasted from [[3681 BBY]] to [[3653 BBY]],<ref name="Warfare" /> the Imperial [[Dreadnaught/Legends|dreadnaught]] ''[[Warhammer]]'' was '''captured''' by Republic forces. Taking place sometime after [[Operation: Freefall]], the mission saw the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] successfully boarded and control of the vessel transferred to the Republic, but two individuals were able to evade capture by the Republic&mdash;one of whom was [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Eckard Lokin]], who was not listed on the crew roster. Lokin was later identified as [[Fixer (Imperial Intelligence)|Fixer]] Fifteen, an agent of [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]], during [[Operation: Red Cell]].<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
The capture of the ''Warhammer'' was first mentioned in the Codex entry for Doctor Lokin in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]].<ref name="Codex" />
